headline: UK backs climate statement advocating targeted levies on high-polluting sectors
summary: The UK signed a statement at the UN climate summit supporting levies on heavy polluters to fund climate crisis responses. The move signals potential future taxes on frequent flyers and cryptocurrency operations.
why: The UK Treasury sets national tax policies, and international commitments at COP summits often precede environmental sector levies.

impacts.name: Polluting Industries
impacts.why: Proposed emissions levies increase long-term tax liabilities for high-polluting businesses.
